quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Standalone GE Aerospace post-Vernova/Healthcare spinoffs: FY2025 peak Owner EPS of $8.15 accurately reflects clean standalone continuing operations (44,000+ installed engine base aftermarket annuity), while historical CAGR of -2.4% is an artifact of pre-spin conglomerate earnings in FY2020 ($9.22). Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap (tangible ROIC of 66.97% on $13.5B tangible capital). 5-10Y g of 11.0% driven by shop visit/engine volume (+5.0%), spare parts/services pricing power (+3.5%), aftermarket mix (+1.5%), supply chain drag (-0.5%), and buybacks (+1.5%). Balance sheet is fortress-quality (net debt 0.93x NI, 117.4% FCF conversion). Trades Above PAR at 39.35x peak EPS vs 26.27x PAR multiple ($214.06 PAR Value).
